summary_zh: Handy 是一款免费、开源、可扩展的离线语音转文字桌面应用。按下可配置快捷键说话，语音在本地经 Whisper 等模型识别后，文字会直接粘贴到当前使用的任意文本框中，无需将音频上传云端。
audience_zh: 适合在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上希望快速听写、且注重隐私、不愿将语音发送到云端的用户，也适合喜欢开源工具并可自行扩展的开发者。

evidence.quote: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.

Handy is a cross-platform desktop application that provides simple, privacy-focused speech transcription. Press a shortcut, speak, and have your words appear in any text field. This happens on your own computer without sending any information to the cloud.
4. **Get** your transcribed text pasted directly into whatever app you're using
- Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux
